SUBJECT:
fix(web): fail closed on unknown Claude resume ids and validate model changes
BODY:
Hardening for the Claude Agent SDK sidecar and client (not yet selected for
any session; Claude still runs over ACP).

- sidecar: before resuming, look the session up with the SDK's
  getSessionInfo(id, { dir: cwd }); an unknown id answers init with
  `session not found` and leaves the sidecar uninitialised so a retry works;
  a lookup that throws or times out degrades to resuming and an SDK without
  getSessionInfo skips the check
- sidecar: stop loading an SDK module named by an environment variable; only
  the explicit --sdk-module argument (used by tests) remains
- client: set_model rejects a value the SDK did not advertise, matching how
  the ACP path rejects unadvertised config values
- tests: resume cases against a fake SDK (known, missing, throwing, legacy
  without the lookup), model validation, and a source check that the
  environment route is gone
